Attack by Draw

“The goal when using attack by draw is to "draw" the opponent into a committed attack by baiting them into what looks like an exposed target, then intercepting his/her motion. Or you can execute a motion that invites a counter, and then counter attack them as they take your bait. “

 

The Pull Counter

Here we see one of Mayweather's most effective moves, "the pull counter”. He starts off by leaning on his lead foot exposing himself and inviting his opponents to throw.
When they take the bait Mayweather easily avoids the punch by pulling back changing his weight to the back foot and then coming back with a right hand counter.

 

When you know what your opponent is going to do, it becomes easier to counter them.

Empires rise and fall on the Yulan Continent. Saints, immortal beings of unimaginable power, battle using spells and swords, leaving swathes of destruction in their wake.
